11799|992f6a78.name: Tajarri
11799|992f6a78.text:
The Shrine of Remulos is a sacred place for us in the Cenarion Circle here in Moonglade... so please conduct yourself in a manner befitting a visitor.

A visitor who doesn't want my scimitar buried in them, that is.

11800|d5d73f6c.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|d5d73f6c.text:
In the northern part of Darkshore runs the Cliffspring River, flowing down from the lands now known as Felwood.  As the river flows out and empties out into the Mist's Edge, travel north to where the deepest parts of the ocean begin.  A stone formation that some call the Stone Claw due to its shape is where you may find what you seek.

Be warned - threshers gather by the Stone Claw, and will attack those who trespass on their territory.

1300|e17121fb.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|e17121fb.text: Hmm... the things you need to learn are a little above my head. Have a talk with Sellandus over at Larson's Clothiers just up the path to the right. He taught me everything I know!

1307|23d8b931.name: Charys Yserian
1307|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1314|23d8b931.name: Duncan Cullen
1314|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1318|23d8b931.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1347|23d8b931.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

2367|c2467ddc.name: Donald Rabonne
2367|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2485|6e89a35a.name: Larimaine Purdue
2485|6e89a35a.text: As a $c, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

5502|bb901712.name: Shylamiir
5502|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

5566|bb901712.name: Tannysa
5566|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

8965|bb0bc8e7.name: Shawn
8965|bb0bc8e7.text: Hello there ma'am... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

918|b0da17d0.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|b0da17d0.text: I got something for you, $N. Looks important.

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-progress.title: The Totem of Infliction

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

120-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
120-complete.text:
At ease, $c.

Magistrate Solomon is a noble leader.  His words carry great weight with me.  I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him.  Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support.  Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.
120-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-accept.name: General Marcus Jonathan
121-accept.text:
While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. 

Dismissed, $c!
121-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

149-complete.name: Blind Mary
149-complete.text:
What is this?  A comb?  It's lovely!  And it glides through my hair as if it weren't the stiff, stringy horror that it is.

Oh, if only I had a mirror...
149-complete.title: Ghost Hair Thread

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

154-accept.name: Blind Mary
154-accept.text:
NO!!!!!

Take it, take this comb away from me!

I'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!
154-accept.title: Return the Comb

154-complete.name: Madame Eva
154-complete.text: I can make a spool of Ghost Hair Thread with this, and have a few strands to spare.  Here are some coins for those extra strands.
154-complete.title: Return the Comb

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

156-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-progress.text: Hi, $N.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
156-progress.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

157-accept.name: Madame Eva
157-accept.text: Here is your thread, $N.  It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.
157-accept.title: Deliver the Thread

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

159-progress.name: Abercrombie
159-progress.text: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
159-progress.title: Juice Delivery

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

167-complete.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-complete.text: My suspicions were correct.  My poor brother.... Well, thank you for bringing some conclusion to this mystery, even if the conclusion was grim.
167-complete.title: Oh Brother...

167-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-progress.text: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
167-progress.title: Oh Brother...

168-complete.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-complete.text: Thank you for collecting these, $N.  Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy.  I will see to it that the families are notified.
168-complete.title: Collecting Memories

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

184-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
184-progress.text:
You have the deed to my farm??  That's good news!  Some ruffians stole it days ago... I thought it was gone for good!

Please, let me have it.  We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...
184-progress.title: Furlbrow's Deed

1921-progress.name: Wynne Larson
1921-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Jennea told me you would come.  Do you have something for me?
1921-progress.title: Gathering Materials

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

214-progress.name: Scout Riell
214-progress.text: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang?  If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

230-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
230-complete.text:
<Sven reads the book's pages, then slams it shut.>

That shadowy figure I saw was a witness to my family's death!  There are questions I'd like to ask that man...if only I knew who he was!
230-complete.title: Sven's Camp

230-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
230-progress.text: You found what??  Please, let me see it...
230-progress.title: Sven's Camp

26-accept.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
26-accept.text:
$N, I have been following your progress with much delight.  You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.

The time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water.  For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there.  He will guide you further.
26-accept.title: A Lesson to Learn

26-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
26-complete.text:
Salutations, young $c; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form.  It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water.  You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.

You will face two trials to overcome.  The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure.  The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.

Stand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.
26-complete.title: A Lesson to Learn

2609-accept.name: Doc Mixilpixil
2609-accept.text:
It's unanimous, $N. You've got the 'itis.'

Luckily, I have a cure for the 'itis.'

Here's what I need: One bundle of simple wildflowers, one leaded vial, one bronze tube, and last but certainly not least, one spool of light chartreuse silk thread. Ol' Emma left a spool of it for me at 'The Finest Thread.' You can find the shop along the canals.

Hurry along now, $N, and try not to touch anyone until you're cured. Oh, and Dr. Montgomery says you need a shower -- his words, not mine.
2609-accept.title: The Touch of Zanzil

262-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
262-accept.text:
I must know who was that skulker in the shadows I saw the night my family was killed!

Please, $N, you have shown your resourcefulness.  Please find that shadowy figure.  I must learn what secrets he holds!

I do not have clues that you do not already know, but here - take the book you found at my farm.  Perhaps some of the townsfolk can link this book with its owner.
262-accept.title: The Shadowy Figure

262-complete.name: Madame Eva
262-complete.text:
Hmm... Someone handled this book recently, someone who is driven by revenge.  But the impressions left on it, at least the impressions from the original owner, are faint.

I can tell, however, that the original owner of this book is not a native of Darkshire.
262-complete.title: The Shadowy Figure

262-progress.name: Madame Eva
262-progress.text: If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it.  I may be able to divine something of its owner.
262-progress.title: The Shadowy Figure

265-accept.name: Madame Eva
265-accept.text:
Here is your book back, $N, and I bid you fortune with your search.  If you ask others in town, perhaps they can offer you more clues.

And here is one more for you - although the author of this book is a stranger to Darkshire, the book itself was purchased here.
265-accept.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

265-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
265-complete.text:
Ah, yes.  I sold this book a month ago to a shady person.  He didn't tell me his name, but he was a nervous, jittery chap, always looking over his shoulder.

I hope that helps you...
265-complete.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

265-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
265-progress.text:
Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.

I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...
265-progress.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

266-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
266-accept.text:
Here is your book, and good luck with your inquiries.

You might want to expand your search to the inn.  If the person whom you seek spent time in town, then chances are someone saw him there.
266-accept.title: Inquire at the Inn

266-complete.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-complete.text:
Oh yeah, I remember this book.  Its owner rented a room for a few days, and spent his nights at the bar, writing.

He left town in a hurry, muttering about being hunted by...something.  Last I saw him he was heading west out of town, looking for a new spot to hide.

The first place he'd find to the west is Raven Hill...
266-complete.title: Inquire at the Inn

266-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-progress.text:
The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.

If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.
266-progress.title: Inquire at the Inn

268-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
268-progress.text: Did you find who the Shadowy Figure was?
268-progress.title: Return to Sven

272-accept.name: Tajarri
272-accept.text:
For the second trial, you'll need the two halves that make the Pendant of the Sea Lion.  One half draws power from the agility of the sea lion aspect, gliding through water; the other draws power from the incredible endurance of the sea lion aspect.  Druids draw on both these traits equally to embody the aspect of their aquatic form.

Speak with the locals of Moonglade to learn where the parts may lie, and bring both here to join them together.  Once formed, take the pendant to Dendrite Starblaze.
272-accept.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

272-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
272-complete.text:
You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, $N - congratulations.

Each task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater.  Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without your willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.

Remember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.
272-complete.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

272-progress.name: Dendrite Starblaze
272-progress.text: Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, $N?  If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information.  Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
272-progress.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

29-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
29-accept.text:
For your first trial, search the depths of Lake Elune'ara to locate a Shrine Bauble.  It decays rapidly, so proceed with it to the Shrine of Remulos post haste.  Use the bauble at the shrine, and then speak with Tajarri there; she is one of Moonglade's most trusted wardens.

You only have a set amount of time to complete the task, and you may be competing against other druids searching for baubles themselves.  Mental and physical dexterity will be critical to your success.

Good luck, $N.
29-accept.title: Trial of the Lake

29-complete.name: Tajarri
29-complete.text:
Well now, it looks like yet another $c has successfully completed the Trial of the Lake!  Well done, my young friend - well done.

As I've said, my name is Tajarri.  It is my duty and my privilege to serve as a warden for Moonglade, and specifically this shrine.  Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance, and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such.  By using the bauble here, it serves as a nod to the importance of this place within the Circle.
29-complete.title: Trial of the Lake

29-progress.name: Tajarri
29-progress.text: To complete the Trial of the Lake, you must use the Shrine Bauble within the boundaries of this shrine.  Until you do so, your trial remains unfinished and it is at risk of failure.
29-progress.title: Trial of the Lake

2928-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2928-accept.text:
It's terrible, $N. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.

What we need are spare parts, $N. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.

What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.
2928-accept.title: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

3765-accept.name: Argos Nightwhisper
3765-accept.text:
Stormwind -- such a bustling hub of activity.

I have traveled from afar to seek help. Often it is heard that brave adventurers roam these city streets.

My brother, Gershala, requires assistance in Darkshore. He resides in the seaside town of Auberdine.

The journey is a long and epic one. It is for this reason that I ask the help of a seasoned $c such as yourself.
3765-accept.title: The Corruption Abroad

38-accept.name: Salma Saldean
38-accept.text:
Help me make some Westfall Stew!  Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-accept.title: Westfall Stew

453-accept.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
453-accept.text:
Good luck, $N.  I hope you find the chap, and I hope you find him alive.

If he's left the safety of Darkshire then he could be prey to the beasts of the wilds.
453-accept.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

453-progress.name: Jitters
453-progress.text: Who are you??  Leave me be!
453-progress.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

5061-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5061-accept.text:
You have completed the necessary lessons all young druids are taught before they can adopt an aquatic aspect.  Go now back to your trainer, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, in Darnassus.  Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you.  He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.

Goodbye, young $c.  We shall speak again.
5061-accept.title: Aquatic Form

5061-complete.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
5061-complete.text:
Very impressive, $N.  You are ready to learn your aquatic form, and it is my pleasure to teach it to you.

Also, in recognition of your achievement during the two trials, I give you this item.  I hope you'll find it to be a welcome addition to your gear as a protector of nature and a keeper of the balance.
5061-complete.title: Aquatic Form

5061-progress.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
5061-progress.text:
Your return to Darnassus is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in Moonglade before I will teach you your aquatic form.

Do you have the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
5061-progress.title: Aquatic Form

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

6122-complete.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6122-complete.text:
By Elune, this water is disgusting!  No wonder the deer are sick.

Something is polluting the water, and in turn corrupting Darkshore's entire water table.  Sick deer have been seen all over area, and not just by the river.  While this water is most likely a primary source of the sickness spreading, there's something else at work here.

This water, believe it or not, will help us formulate a cure.  While I research this water, I have need of some items to formulate a cure...
6122-complete.title: The Principal Source

6122-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6122-progress.text:
You're the one that the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade sent?  That's wonderful!  We've quite the crisis our hands here regarding the poor deer, and we're happy for all the help we can get.

Do you have the sample of water that Dendrite Starblaze said you'd have?  He notified me that you'd draw one so we could work on a cure together...
6122-progress.title: The Principal Source

6123-accept.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6123-accept.text:
The water will serve as the base of the curative salve I'll make for the deer.  For curative properties, I need some earthroot.  Herbalists know how to find it, so if we're unlucky and you aren't one then you'll need to find one to help us out.

Finally for potency, I need some lunar fungus.  Finding lunar fungal blooms is easy enough; they're all over the place in caves just to the east of here.  Moonkin reside in the caves and they're irritable as of late, so be careful.
6123-accept.title: Gathering the Cure

6123-complete.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6123-complete.text:
This is good, $N, so much so that it should be enough to make some ample doses of the salve - at least enough to start to make a difference.

Making a cure for poisons can be quite difficult at times because each one often requires a very specific antidote to counteract it.  Imagine being able to cure a poison at will without having to worry about the exact ingredients of what the antidote must be!

Now, let me get to work on this!
6123-complete.title: Gathering the Cure

6123-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6123-progress.text: Have you got the reagents I need to make the salve?  The deer aren't getting any better on their own, so we better hurry to help them out!
6123-progress.title: Gathering the Cure

6124-accept.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6124-accept.text:
The amount of salve made out of the reagents you brought me is good enough for ten doses, $N.  While I work with the village to try and make some more salve, I'd like for you to help us get a head start.  All around Darkshore are sickly deer; use the salve on them and cure their malaise.

Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade will want to talk to you when you're done, I'm sure.  Please extend Auberdine's thanks to the Cenarion Circle there... and let me say thanks to you directly for the help you've given!
6124-accept.title: Curing the Sick

6124-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
6124-complete.text:
You have done well in tending to the sickly deer of Darkshore; they are unwitting victims of a greater taint and corruption that is spreading all throughout the land.  There are those in Darnassus who choose to recognize this threat... and there are those who ignore the growing signs.  I hope you will not be one to put blinders on about what facts stare you in the face, $N.

Regardless, you've proven your worth as a friend of nature and the Circle - take this as a symbol of such.
6124-complete.title: Curing the Sick

6125-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
6125-accept.text:
You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid.  Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.

You should now return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, $N.  He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto her.

Farewell, young $c.  We shall speak again.
6125-accept.title: Power over Poison

6125-complete.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
6125-complete.text:
Welcome back - I've been following your progress on this lesson since you left, and I must admit I was surprised to learn about the situation in Auberdine.  This does bear some further investigation, as the introduction of such poisons into the environment is most upsetting to the balance.

You handled yourself with grace under pressure.  For that, I can find no better way to reward you than with permanent power over poison.  Use it well, $N... use it well.
6125-complete.title: Power over Poison

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

83-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
83-progress.text: I'm running low on linen, $N.  Do you have any for me?
83-progress.title: Red Linen Goods

91-progress.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-progress.text: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-progress.title: Solomon's Law

91732-progress.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-progress.text: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732-progress.title: Good Steel

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

94449-accept.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
94449-accept.text:
It's been long since ye were last tested, $N. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye. 

Seek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.
94449-accept.title: Call of Fire

94449-complete.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94449-complete.text: Hmm... that elder sent ye, eh? Well, a $c's word is solid, so I'll not argue. That means ye're ready for the next sapta. The sapta of fire. I see it in yer eyes already -- the burnin', the hunger. Ye've tasted power, and now ye want more. But mind yerself, $N. Remember what the stone taught ye. Fire's easy to wield, but harder to master. Know when to hold back.
94449-complete.title: Call of Fire

94465-accept.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94465-accept.text:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame. 

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465-accept.title: Call of Fire

94465-complete.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94465-complete.text:
Ah, me apologies, $N. Didn't spot the Torch in yer hand. An honor to meet ye proper.

Many a wanderer climbs these heights chasin' tales of treasure or beasts, only to find naught but stone and silence. But we know better, don't we, $N?

This shrine holds truths far deeper than the Alliance can fathom. To us, it's a sacred flame that waits to be awakened.
94465-complete.title: Call of Fire

94465-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94465-progress.text:
Greetin's, $N. Ye've made it to the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame, eh? Not many do. Only those well-versed in the $c's path can grasp the secrets this place holds. 

Shame ye came all this way just to be turned back--the climb's no stroll through Dun Morogh. But I'm the shrine's keeper, and I won't be lettin' just any foot trod about.
94465-progress.title: Call of Fire

94466-accept.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-accept.text:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, $N? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.
94466-accept.title: Call of Fire

96390-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96390-accept.text:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390-accept.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

98387-accept.name: Marshal Marris
98387-accept.text:
You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387-accept.title: Blackrock Blockade
